business: Kopi Senja (an example: a grab-and-go kopi susu kiosk in South Jakarta)
target: Office workers and students in South Jakarta, 20 to 35, who buy iced coffee 3 or more times a week
where: South Jakarta, around Blok M and the MRT

behaviours.name: Promo hunter
behaviours.how: Buys where the e-wallet cashback or app voucher is best this week.

behaviours.name: Orders on the app
behaviours.how: Orders coffee on GoFood or GrabFood to the office, rarely walks to a counter.

behaviours.name: Daily regular
behaviours.how: Buys the same es kopi susu at the same place on the way in.

behaviours.name: Checks TikTok first
behaviours.how: Tries a new place only after seeing it on TikTok or Instagram.

behaviours.name: Loyal to a big chain
behaviours.how: Has the app of a big kopi susu chain and collects its points.

behaviours.name: Payday treat
behaviours.how: Spends freely after payday, cuts back in the lean days before the next one.

behaviours.name: Less sugar
behaviours.how: Asks for less sugar, avoids drinks that feel heavy.
